Recompute the true APE implied by a pinned DGP

Source: R/invert.R
true_ape.Rd

Recompute the true APE implied by a pinned DGP

Usage

true_ape(dgp)

Arguments

dgp

A powerape_dgp after set_ape().

Value

The true APE (numeric scalar), evaluated on the deterministic integration set; equals the set_ape() target up to root-finding tolerance.
